scope: Synthetic smoke and regression evaluation. A selection remains provisional until representative independently checked raw captures are added.
comparison: Use identical frozen evidence, candidate schema and grounding revision; compare development and holdout separately. Freeze strategy versions before the first holdout call. Record order and repeated runs before interpreting latency differences.
hardFailures: Any source-reviewed unsupported grounded factual assertion.
Any dropped negation, condition or optionality on an asserted retained clause.
Any wrong-but-source-present numeric value associated with an ingredient, component or step.
Any evidence fingerprint mismatch or unreported acquisition loss.
Any paid dispatch outside the existing provider-accounting boundary.
benefit: Require paired improvements in source-supplied field precision/recall and correction burden or usable recipe count. Inspect regressions by field and case; do not hide them in an aggregate average. No improvement percentage is preselected without an application reason.
hybrid: Consider only if the frozen local candidate has a reproducible gap the bounded fallback can address; report trigger frequency, fallback invocations, latency and known/estimated spend separately. Preserve the installed default until evidence justifies a product decision.
unknowns: Missing usage, spend, invocation counts, latency and absent expected facts are unavailable/null, never zero or 100 percent. Reservations are not actual spend.
review: Canonical oracle mismatch is not automatically a hallucination. Review every unmatched fact against its local witness and qualifiers before classifying it. Unreviewed mismatches block a selection; never tune the oracle solely to a model answer.
statistics: Twenty synthetic cases and ten-case splits support descriptive paired smoke/regression counts only, not population accuracy, statistical superiority, real acquisition recall, or model claims. Scripted fixtures verify the harness, not an extractor.
